endorsements.name: Martin Herfurt
endorsements.label: Project TEMPA - Demystifying Tesla's Bluetooth Passive Entry System
endorsements.description: The security of Tesla's cars has been a hot topic in recent months. In addition to being one of the safest cars on the road, it is also well-protected from hacks and attacks. But how does Tesla make sure their vehicles are safe and secure? This case study sheds light on the inner workings of Tesla's Passive Entry System and core VCSEC protocol, and reveals possible attack vectors.
endorsements.subtitle: CanSecWest 2022
